findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 10 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 21 questions numbered 1-21; by section: 10.1 1, 10.1.1 1, 10.1.2 3, 10.2 2, 10.3 3, 10.4 2, 10.5 2, 10.6 4, 10.7 3.

The unit's proofs (fundamental law by the distance formula, sin(a + b) and tan(a + b) from the law, sin 3a and cos 3a, sum to product) and the main problem types (distance and triangle shape, allied angles, sum formulas with quadrant signs, r sin(theta + phi) with greatest and least values, double, half and triple angles, power reduction, sums of cosines). Angles and numbers are our own; every step and final answer was checked by computation in Python (sympy, check10_long.py). Book corrections followed: cos(pi/2 + theta) = -sin theta, tan(270 deg + theta) = -cot theta, tan 3a (not tan cubed).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
